title: Fixed rules opens sorted by Part Number A to Z with an up arrow
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with the Settings - Parts permission.
  • Category {Category-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PC46 cat) exists.
  • Fixed rule part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PC46-10AB) is at {Location-A} in category {Category-A} with fixed price (for example 15.00).
  • Fixed rule part {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PC46-109CD) is at {Location-A} in category {Category-A} with fixed price (for example 15.00).
  • Fixed rule part {Part-C} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PC46-10954) is at {Location-A} in category {Category-A} with fixed price (for example 15.00).
  • No other fixed rule at {Location-A} has a part number starting with the same tag (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PC46).
  • You are on a page other than Pricing and the Pricing Search box is empty.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Settings and click Pricing in the Parts group of the Settings menu.
  2. Click the Fixed rules tab.
  3. Wait until the loading indicator on the Fixed rules tab disappears.
  4. Move the mouse pointer away from the column headers.
  5. Look at the three column headers.
  6. Read the order of {Part-A}, {Part-B} and {Part-C}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: the Part Number header shows an arrow pointing up. Category and Fixed Price show no arrow.
  • Step 6: the rows read {Part-A}, {Part-B}, {Part-C} (10AB, 109CD, 10954). The numbers inside the part numbers compare as numbers: 10, then 109, then 10954.
  • Step 6: the order is not today's character-by-character order, which would read 10954, 109CD, 10AB.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11258; story SV-10136 (Story 3, Fixed Rules, sortable columns; story text re-synced to the PRD on 13 Oct 2026); PRD "Settings Pricing And Categories Sorting (Price/Category)", Confluence 578781186, version 21 (14 Oct 2026), S3-R12, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas boards 1.4 (Fixed rules - before and after) and 2.1 (The three rules that bite), 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct. Product comment: Chris Ward, 23 Sep 2026 (Confluence comment 882311473), first comment item 2: the opening order does change, S3-R12 reworded. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Price/Category QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R12: “The list opens sorted by Part number ascending (numeric-aware, per S3-R6), and that header shows the ascending arrow.”
  • S3-R6: “Part number sorts alphabetically, ignores whether letters are upper case or lower case, and compares numbers inside a part number as numbers: `BRK-9`, then `BRK-10`, then `BRK-100`.”
  • SV-10136 acceptance criteria: “Given the Fixed Rules tab opens, then the list is in Part number order ascending and that header shows the ascending arrow.”
